chapter_name: Fundamental Skills of Sports Table Tennis
learning_objective: 🎯 Master the fast-paced game of Table Tennis by learning how to grip the racket, serve like a champion, and smash the ball with perfect timing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The first step in Table Tennis is holding the racket properly. The Shakehand grip is the most common style, where you hold the handle just like you are shaking hands with a friend!
Every point starts with a serve! You must toss the ball straight up from a flat palm and hit it so it bounces on your side of the table first, then goes over the net to your opponent.
These are your basic attacking shots to keep the rally going. You use a forehand drive when the ball comes to your strong side, and a backhand drive when it comes across your body.
Table Tennis is all about tricky spins! By brushing the ball with your racket, you can create topspin to make the ball dip down fast, confusing your opponent and scoring points.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Wall Bounce Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Stand facing a wall and use a table tennis racket (or a small hardcover book) to hit a ping pong ball against the wall continuously without letting it drop. Count your highest score!

quick_recap: ⭐ Table Tennis requires lightning-fast reflexes, excellent hand-eye coordination, and mastering grips like the Shakehand.
⭐ Knowing how to serve properly and using forehand and backhand drives are the secret keys to building long, exciting rallies.
